name: OpenLoco
description:
OpenLoco is an open-source reimplementation of Chris Sawyer's Locomotion, the transport management simulation successor to Transport Tycoon. It reconstructs the original assembly code into modern, maintainable C++.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit systems with high-resolution support
- Modern user interface enhancements, UI scaling, and multi-monitor compatibility
- Full compatibility with original Locomotion scenarios, vehicles, and save games
- Active bug fixing and performance optimizations over the original 2004 release
- Requires original Chris Sawyer's Locomotion game assets to run
